lines.text: These signals pile up — product usage, intent, noise. The weekly queue arrives late, or unexplained.
One transparent surface — a weekly work queue. 120 accounts, routed to the right owner.
Same capacity. The gated policy qualifies 25, routes 12, defers 13. No gates.
Why this route? Intent explicit — a hand raiser. The naive score: 47, and said no.
An intent minimum, a weekly capacity — bounded scenario controls. Overflow stays visibly deferred.
